about_the_game:
Centuries ago, a wise ruler won the god’s sacred game and asked for immortality—to rule forever in peace. But endless life shattered his soul, turning the protector into a tyrant. The kingdom burned, the king vanished, and chaos reigned. Now, warlords and nobles fight over the ashes, and the desperate prayers of the people have reached the heavens. In answer, the god deals the cards once more—not to choose a savior, but to test ambition. You are one of the chosen challengers. With only your tokens, your wit, and divine favor, you will face rivals in a battle of deception, power, and timing. Only one can rise. Only one can win the god’s favor.

You are one of the chosen challengers, cast into a divine game of deception. Raise or fold—every move is a test of nerve and wit. Outplay rivals not just with cards, but with strategy, courage, and cold-blooded resolve. Only one can rise. Only one will claim the god’s favor.

Total Cardfare is a fast-paced, multiplayer strategy game where divine power fuels ruthless player-versus-player mind games.

💠 Wield the Power of the Gods
Earn God’s blessing orbs by calling and raising. Spend them to activate powerful abilities:

  • Challenge – Force the next player to raise or fold

  • Curse – Drain 2 orbs from the previous player

  • Discipline – Make yourself immune to Challenge and Curse this round

  • Prey – All non-folded opponents lose 5 orbs

💠 Outlast to Reign
Start with 80 tokens. Lose them all and you're out. Every decision is a gamble—and sometimes, the best hand isn't what wins.

💠 Use Items to Shift Fate
Every fourth round, a mysterious merchant appears with three random items. Tools like the Monocle, Compass, Cross, Bell, and Hammer let you bend the rules—if you know when to strike.

💠 Bet Your Faith on Future Hands
Carry orbs into the next hand to unlock stronger starting cards. The more you save, the closer you draw to the god’s chosen hand—but divine favor can be a double-edged sword.

💠 A Myth Reignited

The fallen king walks again, bound by a cursed helmet that returned his sanity but stole his freedom. But he is not the only one playing. Step into the roles of cunning nobles, ruthless warlords, or forgotten heirs—each with their own personality and flair.

The god watches all.

This isn't just a game of cards. It's a battle of minds—and you play to win.
